contracts.claim: Every connection has an honest state, a plain reason and a next step. Sign-in uses the provider's own flow: Claude, Codex and OpenCode in their terminal, Kimi's native browser flow. A test receipt only counts while connected; account material never reaches the card.
impact: Runtime page and first-run Connect step

contracts.claim: No install starts before the exact consent; fixed official package routes run hidden, stream progress, install missing prerequisites, and verify the version before success. Failure or restart offers Retry.
